title: Reproducing Krzeminski et al. 2007: thin dry oxides, Massoud's kinetics and a furnace cycle at 725 and 750 °C

sample.ours: FAMILY: Si_Planar; ORIENTATION: Si100; DOPING: p_type_5e15 (recorded)

sample.paper: HF-dipped; no oxide stated at loading. “An oxide of 1.53 nm (resp. 1.96 nm) is grown for a preoxidation ramp of 30 minutes”
sample.ours: the thin-oxide program starts every history at its fitted 1.71 nm, whatever the sample
sample.note: The language has no starting-oxide field a program reads, so an HF-last surface and a 1 nm oxide start the same.

sample.paper: “Each sample has an 1.0 nm initial oxide prior to oxidation”; orientation, clean and doping not given in this paper
sample.ours: ORIENTATION: Si100 (assumed); STARTING_OXIDE: 1.0_nm (recorded, read by nothing); the program starts at 1.71 nm
sample.note: The 1.71 nm is fitted to Massoud's curves, so it stands for the 1.0 nm plus a fast first regime.

sample.paper: not stated; uniformity under 2% at 725 °C with the oxygen ramp, up to 16% with an inert ramp

history.paper: “[100] silicon substrates (p type doped 5× 10^15 at/cm3) that previously received a RCA cleaning and 1% HF dip.”
history.ours: CLEAN: peroxide_HF on the sample; no operator reads it

history.paper: “The sample introduction is performed at a temperature lower by 50°C than the main temperature step.”
history.note: 675 °C is read from the axis of Fig. 9. Gas and time at the loading temperature are not given, so it is not a RUN.

history.item: Pre-oxidation ramp 675 → 725 °C, 30 min, 9% oxygen in nitrogen
history.paper: “a temperature ramp is applied to reach the desired temperature during 30 minutes. The ambient is composed by a main flux of nitrogen (2 L/min) and a small amount of oxygen (0.2 L/min).” “An oxide of 1.53 nm (resp. 1.96 nm) is grown for a preoxidation ramp of 30 minutes at 725°C (resp. 750 °C)”
history.ours: RUN Ramp DURATION 1800 TEMP 675->725 AMBIENT mix:N2=0.909,O2=0.0909
history.note: Not in the datasets' recipe: their time zero is the end of this ramp. The gas fraction is the flow ratio. No program reads the oxygen pressure, so the ramp grows as if in pure oxygen; its duration is searched as a stand-in for the oxygen it delivers.

history.paper: “Finally, the oxidation stage is realized under an enhanced oxygen flux of (2 L/min).”
history.ours: RUN Oxidation DURATION 3600 TEMP 725->725 AMBIENT dry_O2
history.note: Whether the nitrogen flow continues is not stated; written as pure oxygen. Moisture is not stated.

history.paper: “The final step consists in an inert nitrogen atmosphere for a ramp down during 10 min. and by a thermal reflow of 30 min. No growth is expected during this phase.”
history.ours: RUN RampDown DURATION 600 TEMP 725->675 AMBIENT inert_N2
history.note: The end temperature is read from Fig. 9.

history.paper: “… and by a thermal reflow of 30 min.”; its purpose is “to improve the electrical properties of the oxide film and to reduces the amount of interface defects.”
history.ours: RUN Reflow DURATION 1800 TEMP 675->675 AMBIENT inert_N2
history.note: The reflow temperature is not in the text; Fig. 9 draws it at the loading level.

history.paper: not stated in the manuscript; an uncaptioned French figure (PDF p. 50) shows a 10 min “sortie” 675 → 600 °C in nitrogen
history.ours: the history ends with the reflow

history.paper: “Oxide thickness has been measured by a spectroscopic ellipsometer.” Table II checks two wafers by TEM: 18.90 ± 0.3 against 19 ± 1.0 Å, 27.10 ± 0.3 against 27 ± 1.0 Å
history.note: The delay in air before measurement is not given; an uncaptioned figure (PDF p. 35) shows 0.25 to 0.37 nm of growth over 90 min of exposure.

history.paper: only “at atmospheric pressure from 800°C to 1000°C” and the 1.0 nm starting oxide
history.ours: RUN Oxidation at T in dry_O2 for the time of each point (sampled within the RUN, as in situ)
history.note: Massoud's own paper would give the ramp and time zero; this one does not.

steps.name: Clean
steps.label: RCA clean, then 1% HF dip
steps.paper: “[100] silicon substrates (p type doped 5× 10^15 at/cm3) that previously received a RCA cleaning and 1% HF dip.”
steps.timing: Time from the HF dip to loading: not given

steps.name: Load
steps.label: Loaded at 675 °C
steps.paper: “The sample introduction is performed at a temperature lower by 50°C than the main temperature step.”
steps.timing: Duration and gas: not given

steps.name: Ramp
steps.label: Pre-oxidation ramp 675 → 725 °C, 30 min, 9% oxygen in nitrogen
steps.isl: RUN Ramp DURATION 1800 TEMP 675->725 AMBIENT mix:N2=0.909,O2=0.0909
steps.paper: “a temperature ramp is applied to reach the desired temperature during 30 minutes. The ambient is composed by a main flux of nitrogen (2 L/min) and a small amount of oxygen (0.2 L/min).” “An oxide of 1.53 nm (resp. 1.96 nm) is grown for a preoxidation ramp of 30 minutes at 725°C (resp. 750 °C)”
steps.timing: 30 min stated; the ramp's start (50 °C below) from Fig. 9; linear shape assumed

steps.name: Oxidation
steps.label: Main stage at 725 °C, 60 min, oxygen
steps.isl: RUN Oxidation DURATION 3600 TEMP 725->725 AMBIENT dry_O2
steps.paper: “Finally, the oxidation stage is realized under an enhanced oxygen flux of (2 L/min).”
steps.timing: Times are the abscissae of Figs. 10–12 (0 to 90 min); Fig. 9 labels the stage “[10−90] min”

steps.name: RampDown
steps.label: Ramp down 725 → 675 °C, 10 min, nitrogen
steps.isl: RUN RampDown DURATION 600 TEMP 725->675 AMBIENT inert_N2
steps.paper: “The final step consists in an inert nitrogen atmosphere for a ramp down during 10 min. and by a thermal reflow of 30 min. No growth is expected during this phase.”
steps.timing: 10 min stated; temperatures from Fig. 9

steps.name: Reflow
steps.label: Reflow at 675 °C, 30 min, nitrogen
steps.isl: RUN Reflow DURATION 1800 TEMP 675->675 AMBIENT inert_N2
steps.paper: “… and by a thermal reflow of 30 min.”; its purpose is “to improve the electrical properties of the oxide film and to reduces the amount of interface defects.”
steps.timing: 30 min stated; temperature from Fig. 9 only

steps.name: Unload
steps.label: Unloaded and cooled
steps.paper: not stated in the manuscript; an uncaptioned French figure (PDF p. 50) shows a 10 min “sortie” 675 → 600 °C in nitrogen
steps.timing: Not in the manuscript

steps.name: Measure
steps.label: Ex-situ spectroscopic ellipsometry
steps.paper: “Oxide thickness has been measured by a spectroscopic ellipsometer.” Table II checks two wafers by TEM: 18.90 ± 0.3 against 19 ± 1.0 Å, 27.10 ± 0.3 against 27 ± 1.0 Å
